idea-plugin.name: Docstring Freshness Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Docstring Freshness Monitor — Keep Your Documentation as Fresh as Your Code

Detect stale documentation automatically using git history analysis. Every docstring gets a freshness score (0-100) so you know which docs are trustworthy and which are outdated.

Features

  • Freshness Scoring — 0-100 score for every docstring based on git history
  • Gutter Icons — Visual indicators: 🟢 Fresh, 🟡 Aging, 🔴 Stale
  • Hover Tooltips — Last code/doc change dates and divergent commit count
  • Stale Doc Inspection — IDE inspection with configurable severity
  • Multi-Language — Java/Kotlin, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Mark as Reviewed — Quick-fix to acknowledge stale docs
  • All languages enabled simultaneously
  • Project dashboard with treemap visualization
  • Trend analysis tracking
  • Export reports (HTML, JSON, CSV)
  • CI integration with SARIF and JUnit XML output
  • Custom score algorithm extension point

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)
  • Git repository with history

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/docstring-freshness-monitor

What's New

  • Freshness Scoring - Each docstring gets a 0-100 freshness score based on git history analysis
  • Visual Gutter Icons - Color-coded indicators showing documentation status: green (fresh), yellow (aging), red (stale)
  • Hover Tooltips - Shows last code change, last doc change, and number of divergent commits
  • Stale Documentation Inspection - IDE inspection that flags outdated documentation with configurable severity
  • Multi-Language Support - Works with Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Git-Powered Analysis - Uses git blame and log to detect when code changes but docs don't
  • Mark as Reviewed - Quick-fix action to acknowledge stale docs without updating them
  • Batch Analysis - Analyze entire project via Analyze → Inspect Code
  • Project Dashboard - Overview of documentation freshness across all files with treemap visualization
  • Export Reports - Generate HTML, JSON, and CSV reports for documentation health tracking
